section.content: 本发明涉及电化学器件领域，具体地，涉及一种锂离子电池。电池的电解液含有电解质盐、非水溶剂和电解液添加剂，所述非水溶剂为碳酸酯类有机溶剂，所述可溶性锂盐含有LiFSI，所述电解液添加剂含有氟代碳酸乙烯酯、亚硫酸丙烯酯、丙烯腈和1,3丙烯磺酸内酯；负极粘结剂通过以下方法制备得到：将LiOH水溶液和聚丙烯酸胶液接触，得到pH值为7～8的混合物，其中，所述聚丙烯酸胶液的溶剂为水，所述聚丙烯酸胶液中聚丙烯酸的含量为15‑25重量％；正极活性物质含有镍钴锰锂酸；负极活性物质含有硅合金。本发明的锂离子电池具有更高的能量密度和较好的循环寿命。

The invention relates to the field of electrochemical devices, in particular to a lithium ion battery. The electrolyte of the battery contains electrolyte salt, a non-aqueous solvent and an electrolyte additive, wherein the non-aqueous solvent is a carbonate organic solvent, the soluble lithium salt contains LiFSI, and the electrolyte additive contains fluoroethylene carbonate, propylene sulfite, acrylonitrile and 1, 3-propylene sultone; the negative electrode binder is prepared by the following method: contacting a LiOH aqueous solution with a polyacrylic acid glue solution to obtain a mixture with a pH value of 7-8, wherein the solvent of the polyacrylic acid glue solution is water, and the content of polyacrylic acid in the polyacrylic acid glue solution is 15-25 wt%; the positive active material contains nickel-cobalt-manganese-lithium acid; the negative electrode active material contains a silicon alloy. The lithium ion battery has higher energy density and better cycle life.

Lithium ion batteryTechnical Field

The invention relates to the field of electrochemical devices, in particular to a lithium ion battery.

Background

Lithium ion power batteries have the advantages of high voltage, high energy, small volume, light weight, wide working temperature range and the like, and are widely applied to various fields. The anode, the cathode and the electrolyte are all key materials of the lithium ion battery, and play different important roles respectively.

For the positive electrode, Li Ni-Co-Mn-Li acida+1NixCoyMnzO2The full charge voltage of the material as the positive active material of the battery can reach 4.4V high voltage, and the reversible gram capacity can be more than 178mAh/g, so that the battery can obtain high energy density, and the charge voltage is close to that of the positive active material of the batteryMore positive active materials have been studied over the years. However, when the nickel-cobalt-manganese-lithium acid material is used as the positive electrode of the existing battery, the battery capacity is quickly attenuated after the battery is charged and discharged for many times, and the nickel-cobalt-manganese-lithium acid material is not suitable for being applied in the industry.

For the negative electrode, graphite is generally used as a negative active material in lithium ion batteries currently in industry, but the theoretical gram capacity of graphite is only 372mAh/g, and the reversible gram capacity of graphite in the current industry is close to the theoretical limit. The state stipulates that the energy density of the battery reaches 300 wh/kg by 2020. However, the theoretical gram capacity of graphite still can not achieve the above regulation of the country. Therefore, in order to increase the energy density of the lithium ion battery, it is a necessary trend to apply materials with higher theoretical gram capacity.

The silicon material is a material with the theoretical gram capacity as high as 4200mAh/g, and therefore, the silicon material is increasingly researched to be used as a negative electrode material of a lithium ion battery. However, when the silicon material is used as a negative electrode material of a lithium ion battery, the silicon material has a serious disadvantage that the volume change is large during the circulation process, and the volume expansion rate is as high as 300% when the silicon material is fully charged, so that the contact among an active substance, a conductive agent, a binder and a current collector of a negative electrode sheet of the battery is lost during the charge and discharge processes of the battery; when the lithium ion battery is charged and discharged at a high multiplying power, the SEI film on the surface of the negative plate is continuously damaged and recombined due to the huge temperature rise on the surface of the battery, and the polarization impedance of the battery is sharply increased; this results in rapid capacity decay and short cycle life of lithium ion batteries, which cannot meet the requirements of industrial application.

In the prior art, sodium carboxymethylcellulose (CMC) and Styrene Butadiene Rubber (SBR) are generally used as binders, but the binders cannot solve the problems and cannot meet the requirements when used for a lithium ion battery with a silicon material as a negative electrode. Therefore, it is very important to research a binder that can be applied to a silicon material as a negative electrode material.

For the electrolyte, the electrolyte functions to conduct electrons between the positive and negative electrodes in the lithium ion battery. When the lithium ion battery is charged and discharged with high multiplying power, the SEI film on the surface of the negative plate is continuously damaged and recombined due to the huge temperature rise on the surface of the battery, the polarization impedance of the battery is rapidly increased, the capacity is rapidly attenuated, and the cycle life is short. This can be improved by optimizing the electrolyte. The same electrolyte is applied to different batteries, which may generate battery capacity and cycle life with great difference, and the good electrolyte should be matched with the positive active material and the negative active material, so that the problems of the positive active material and the negative active material can be inhibited, thereby obviously improving the battery capacity and cycle life of the battery.

In conclusion, the lithium ion battery with better battery capacity and cycle life can be obtained only by matching the anode, the cathode and the electrolyte with each other.

Disclosure of Invention

The invention aims to overcome the defect that the cycle life of the existing lithium ion battery is too short when nickel-cobalt-manganese lithium acid is used as a positive active material and/or silicon alloy is used as a negative active material in order to improve the capacity density of the battery, and provides a novel lithium ion battery. The lithium ion battery of the invention can have higher energy density and still have better cycle life by using the positive active material containing nickel-cobalt-manganese lithium acid and the negative active material containing silicon alloy.

The invention provides a lithium ion battery, which comprises a pole core, an electrolyte and a battery shell, wherein the pole core and the electrolyte are sealed in the battery shell, the pole core comprises a positive pole, a negative pole and a separation film, the positive pole comprises a positive current collector and a positive pole material formed on the positive current collector, the negative pole comprises a negative current collector and a negative pole material formed on the negative current collector, the positive pole material is formed by a positive pole composition, the negative pole material is formed by a negative pole composition, the positive pole composition contains a positive pole active substance, a positive pole conductive agent and a positive pole binder, the negative pole composition contains a negative pole active substance, a negative pole conductive agent and a negative pole binder, the electrolyte contains an electrolyte salt, a non-aqueous solvent and an electrolyte additive,

the non-aqueous solvent is a carbonate organic solvent, the soluble lithium salt contains LiFSI, and the electrolyte additive contains fluoroethylene carbonate, propylene sulfite, acrylonitrile and 1, 3-propylene sultone;

the negative electrode binder is prepared by the following method: contacting a LiOH aqueous solution with a polyacrylic acid glue solution to obtain a mixture with a pH value of 7-8, wherein the solvent of the polyacrylic acid glue solution is water, and the content of polyacrylic acid in the polyacrylic acid glue solution is 15-25 wt%;

the positive electrode active material contains Lia+1NixCoyMnzO2Wherein x + y + z + a is 1, 0<a≤0.1，x≥0.45；

The negative electrode active material contains a silicon alloy.

Through the technical scheme, the specific negative electrode binder is matched with the negative electrode active material containing the silicon alloy, so that the volume expansion phenomenon of the silicon material can be effectively inhibited, and a material similar to an SEI film can be formed on the surface of the negative electrode; by matching the specific electrolyte with the positive active material and the negative active material, the problem that the battery capacity of the lithium ion battery using the nickel-cobalt-manganese-lithium acid as the positive active material is quickly attenuated can be solved, and the problem that a negative SEI film is damaged due to high temperature rise can be effectively solved, so that the service life of the lithium ion battery using the nickel-cobalt-manganese-lithium acid positive active material is effectively prolonged, and the energy density and the capacity retention rate of the lithium ion battery are further improved.

Additional features and advantages of the invention will be set forth in the detailed description which follows.

Detailed Description

The following describes in detail specific embodiments of the present invention. It should be understood that the detailed description and specific examples, while indicating the present invention, are given by way of illustration and explanation only, not limitation.

The endpoints of the ranges and any values disclosed herein are not limited to the precise range or value, and such ranges or values should be understood to encompass values close to those ranges or values. For ranges of values, between the endpoints of each of the ranges and the individual points, and between the individual points may be combined with each other to give one or more new ranges of values, and these ranges of values should be considered as specifically disclosed herein.

The invention provides a lithium ion battery, which comprises a pole core, electrolyte and a battery shell, wherein the pole core and the electrolyte are sealed in the battery shell, the pole core comprises a positive pole, a negative pole and a separation film, the positive pole comprises a positive current collector and a positive pole material formed on the positive current collector, the negative pole comprises a negative current collector and a negative pole material formed on the negative current collector, the positive pole material is formed by a positive pole composition, the negative pole material is formed by a negative pole composition, the positive pole composition contains a positive pole active substance, a positive pole conductive agent and a positive pole binding agent, the negative pole composition contains a negative pole active substance, a negative pole conductive agent and a negative pole binding agent, the electrolyte contains electrolyte salt, non-aqueous solvent and electrolyte additive,

the non-aqueous solvent is a carbonate organic solvent, the soluble lithium salt contains LiFSI (namely lithium bis (fluorosulfonyl) imide), and the electrolyte additive contains fluoroethylene carbonate, propylene sulfite, acrylonitrile and 1, 3-propylene sultone;

the negative electrode binder is prepared by the following method: contacting a LiOH aqueous solution with a polyacrylic acid glue solution to obtain a mixture with a pH value of 7-8, wherein the solvent of the polyacrylic acid glue solution is water, and the content of polyacrylic acid in the polyacrylic acid glue solution is 15-25 wt%;

the positive electrode active material contains Lia+1NixCoyMnzO2Wherein x + y + z + a is 1, 0<a≤0.1，x≥0.45；

The negative electrode active material contains a silicon alloy.

The electrolyte of the lithium ion battery contains electrolyte salt, a non-aqueous solvent and an electrolyte additive.

According to the electrolyte of the lithium ion battery of the present invention, the concentration of the soluble lithium salt may be 0.5 to 2mol/L, preferably 1 to 1.4mol/L, and more preferably 1.1 to 1.3mol/L, relative to the volume of the non-aqueous solvent. The concentration of the soluble lithium salt is calculated based on the volume of the non-aqueous solvent, i.e., 1 to 1.4mol of the soluble lithium salt is added per 1L of the non-aqueous solvent.

According to the electrolyte of the lithium ion battery, the concentration of the LiFSI is preferably 0.1-0.3mol/L, more preferably 0.1-0.3mol/L, and further preferably 0.15-0.25 mol/L.

According to the electrolyte of the lithium ion battery, the soluble lithium salt can also contain LiPF6、LiBF4、LiAsF6、LiClO4Lithium trifluoromethanesulfonate, lithium perfluorobutylsulfonate, LiAlO2、LiAlCl4And lithium fluorosulfonylimide; preferably LiPF6。

According to the electrolyte of the lithium ion battery, the soluble lithium salt preferably consists of LiFSI and another soluble lithium salt. More preferably, the soluble lithium salt is formed from LiFSI and LiPF6And (4) forming. Preferably, the LiFSI and LiPF6The content ratio of (b) may be 1: 1-10, more preferably 1: 3-7.

The electrolyte of the lithium ion battery according to the present invention preferably has a total content of the electrolyte additive of 5 to 25 parts by weight, more preferably 10 to 15 parts by weight, and still more preferably 12 to 13 parts by weight, based on 100 parts by weight of the total content of the nonaqueous solvent and the soluble lithium salt.

In the electrolyte of the lithium ion battery according to the present invention, the content of each component in the electrolyte additive is not particularly limited, and preferably, the content of the fluoroethylene carbonate (FEC) is 5 to 10 parts by weight, the content of the Propylene Sulfite (PS) is 0.5 to 5 parts by weight, the content of the Acrylonitrile (AN) is 0.5 to 3 parts by weight, and the content of the 1,3 propylene sultone (PTS) is 0.5 to 3 parts by weight, based on 100 parts by weight of the total content of the nonaqueous solvent and the soluble lithium salt; more preferably, the fluoroethylene carbonate (FEC) is contained in AN amount of 7 to 9 parts by weight, the Propylene Sulfite (PS) is contained in AN amount of 1 to 3 parts by weight, the Acrylonitrile (AN) is contained in AN amount of 1 to 2 parts by weight, and the 1,3 propylene sultone (PTS) is contained in AN amount of 1 to 2 parts by weight, based on 100 parts by weight of the total content of the nonaqueous solvent and the soluble lithium salt.

In the electrolyte solution for a lithium ion battery according to the present invention, the nonaqueous solvent may be selected from carbonate-based organic solvents, and specific components are not particularly limited. Preferably, the nonaqueous solvent contains Ethylene Carbonate (EC), Ethyl Methyl Carbonate (EMC), and diethyl carbonate (DEC). Preferably, the volume ratio of Ethylene Carbonate (EC), Ethyl Methyl Carbonate (EMC) and diethyl carbonate (DEC) may be 1-3:1: 4-6.

According to a preferred embodiment, the electrolyte of the lithium ion battery comprises a soluble lithium salt, a non-aqueous solvent and an electrolyte additive, wherein the soluble lithium salt is formed by LiFSI and LiPF6Composition, and the concentration of the soluble lithium salt is 0.5-2mol/L, wherein the concentration of LiFSI is 0.1-0.3mol/L, LiFSI and LiPF, relative to the volume of the non-aqueous solvent6The content ratio of (A) is 1: 1-10; the non-aqueous solvent consists of Ethylene Carbonate (EC), Ethyl Methyl Carbonate (EMC) and diethyl carbonate (DEC), and the volume ratio of the EC, the EMC and the DEC is 1-3:1: 4-6; the electrolyte additive comprises four components of fluoroethylene carbonate (FEC), Propylene Sulfite (PS), Acrylonitrile (AN) and 1, 3-propylene sultone (PTS), and the total content of the electrolyte additive is 5-25 parts by weight based on 100 parts by weight of the total content of the non-aqueous solvent and the soluble lithium salt, wherein the content of FEC is 5-10 parts by weight, the content of PS is 0.5-5 parts by weight, the content of AN is 0.5-3 parts by weight, and the content of PTS is 0.5-3 parts by weight.

According to the electrolyte of the lithium ion battery, the injection amount of the electrolyte is preferably 1.5-5 g/Ah.

The negative electrode of the lithium ion battery comprises a negative current collector and a negative electrode material formed on the negative current collector, wherein the negative electrode material is formed by a negative electrode composition, and the negative electrode composition contains a negative electrode active substance, a negative electrode conductive agent and a negative electrode binder.

According to the negative electrode of the lithium ion battery of the present invention, based on the total weight of the negative electrode active material, the negative electrode conductive agent, and the negative electrode binder calculated as polyacrylic acid, the content of the negative electrode active material may be 80 to 96 wt%, the content of the negative electrode conductive agent may be 3 to 10 wt%, and the content of the negative electrode binder calculated as polyacrylic acid may be 0.1 to 10 wt%; preferably, the content of the negative electrode active material is 87 to 91 wt%, the content of the negative electrode conductive agent is 5 to 7 wt%, and the content of the negative electrode binder is 4 to 6 wt%, based on the total weight of the negative electrode active material, the conductive agent, and the negative electrode binder calculated by polyacrylic acid.

According to the negative electrode of the lithium ion battery of the present invention, the negative electrode active material is preferably a mixture of a silicon alloy and graphite. The inventors of the present invention found that when only a silicon alloy is used as a negative electrode active material, the swelling phenomenon is relatively serious and it is difficult to sufficiently suppress the swelling phenomenon, and therefore, the inventors of the present invention found that when a mixture of a silicon alloy and graphite is used as a negative electrode active material in combination, a good balance between the battery energy density and the capacity retention rate can be obtained, and found that a preferable blending ratio.

In the negative electrode of the lithium ion battery according to the present invention, preferably, the content of the silicon alloy is 12 to 20 wt% and the content of the graphite is 80 to 88 wt%, based on the weight of the negative electrode active material; more preferably, the content of the silicon alloy is 14 to 18 wt% and the content of the graphite is 82 to 86 wt% based on the weight of the negative electrode active material.

According to the negative electrode of the lithium ion battery, the content of silicon in the silicon alloy is 20-40 wt%, preferably 25-35 wt%.

According to the negative electrode of the lithium ion battery of the present invention, preferably, the silicon alloy further contains Fe. Based on the weight of the silicon alloy, the content of silicon is 20-40 wt%, and the content of Fe is 60-80 wt%; preferably, the silicon content is 25-35 wt% and the Fe content is 65-75 wt%, based on the weight of the silicon alloy.

According to the negative electrode of the lithium ion battery of the present invention, preferably, the silicon alloy has a particle size of D50 ═ 5 to 6 μm.

According to the negative electrode of the lithium ion battery, the specific surface area of the silicon alloy is preferably 5-20m2/g。

The negative electrode of the lithium ion battery according to the present invention is not particularly limited, and may be graphite conventionally used in lithium ion batteries in the art. The inventors of the present invention have found that flake graphite is more suitable for the present application than spherical graphite, and can achieve better cycle life and energy density. Thus, in the present invention, the morphology of the graphite is flake-like. The graphite is preferably artificial graphite.

According to the negative electrode of the lithium ion battery of the present invention, the graphite preferably has a particle size of D50 ═ 12 to 20 μm.

According to the negative electrode of the lithium ion battery of the present invention, the pH of the mixture obtained during the preparation of the negative electrode binder is preferably 7.3 to 7.8.

According to the negative electrode of the lithium ion battery, the purity of the LiOH crystal used for preparing the LiOH aqueous solution in the preparation process of the negative electrode binder is 97% or more, and preferably 98% or more. The inventor of the invention finds that when the purity of the LiOH crystal reaches 97 percent or even more than 98 percent, the inhibiting effect of the negative electrode binder on the expansion phenomenon of the silicon alloy can be effectively improved, and the aim of the invention is better achieved.

According to the negative electrode of the lithium ion battery of the present invention, the content of LiOH in the LiOH aqueous solution during the preparation of the negative electrode binder may be 1 to 10% by weight, preferably 5 to 8% by weight.

According to the negative electrode of the lithium ion battery, the polyacrylic acid (PAA) glue solution is preferably obtained by dissolving PAA powder in water during the preparation of the negative electrode binder. The PAA may have a weight average molecular weight of 400K to 650K, a crosslinking amount of 0.05 to 0.15%, a glass transition temperature of 100 ℃ and 110 ℃, and a benzene content of less than 0.5 wt%.

According to the negative electrode of the lithium ion battery, the content of polyacrylic acid in the polyacrylic acid glue solution in the preparation process of the negative electrode binder is preferably 18-22 wt%.

According to the negative electrode of the lithium ion battery, the method for contacting the LiOH aqueous solution with the polyacrylic acid glue solution in the preparation process of the negative electrode binder is preferably as follows: and dropwise adding LiOH aqueous solution into the polyacrylic acid glue solution under the stirring condition to perform neutralization reaction.

According to the negative electrode of the lithium ion battery, the solvent water of the LiOH aqueous solution and the polyacrylic acid glue solution in the preparation process of the negative electrode binder is preferably deionized water.

The negative electrode of the lithium ion battery according to the present invention, the negative electrode conductive agent is not particularly limited, and may be various conductive agents conventionally used in the art for negative electrode material compositions, such as one or more of carbon black, acetylene black, furnace black, carbon fiber, graphene, carbon nanotube, conductive carbon black and conductive graphite, preferably carbon black and/or carbon nanotube, and further preferably a mixture of carbon black and carbon nanotube. When the negative electrode conductive agent is a mixture of carbon black and carbon nanotubes, the content of the carbon black is 30-70 wt% and the content of the carbon nanotubes is 30-70 wt% based on the weight of the negative electrode conductive agent. Preferably, the carbon black has an apparent density of 60 to 90kg/m3The specific surface area is 60-80m2A specific conductivity of 102-104S/m, the carbon nanotube refers to a seamless nanotube formed by rolling a single-layer graphite sheet or a plurality of layers of graphite sheets, the carbon nanotube can be single-wall carbon nanotubes (SWCNTs) and/or multi-wall carbon nanotubes (MWCNTs), and preferably, the carbon nanotube is a multi-wall carbon nanotube. The inner diameter ID of the carbon nanotube can be 2-15nm, the outer diameter OD is less than or equal to 30nm, the thickness of the tube wall can be 0.5-10nm, the length can be 5-20 mu m, and the specific surface area can be 150-300m2A specific conductivity of 104-107S/m, preferably, the inner diameter ID of the carbon nanotube is 4-6nm (e.g. 5nm), the outer diameter OD is 5-10nm (e.g. 7nm), the wall thickness is 0.5-2nm (e.g. 1nm), the length is 10-20 μm (e.g. 10-15 μm), and the specific surface area is 200-300m2(e.g. 220- & ltSUB & gt 250 m)2Per g) and an electrical conductivity of 105-107S/m (e.g. 10)5-106S/m)。

According to the negative electrode of the lithium ion battery of the present invention, the negative electrode material composition further contains a negative electrode solvent, the negative electrode solvent is water, and the content of the negative electrode solvent may be 25 to 50 parts by weight, preferably 30 to 40 parts by weight, based on 100 parts by weight of the total content of the negative electrode active material, the negative electrode conductive agent, and the negative electrode binder, which is based on polyacrylic acid.

According to the negative electrode of the lithium ion battery of the present invention, the parameters of the size, the density and the like of the negative current collector and the negative electrode material in the battery negative electrode can be in a conventional manner in the art. More preferably, the anode material has a compacted density of 1.2 to 2g/cm3Preferably 1.5 to 1.7g/cm3. Preferably, the thickness of the negative current collector is 7 to 11 μm, more preferably 8 to 10 μm. Preferably, the total thickness of the battery negative electrode is 100-120 μm, and more preferably 105-115 μm. Preferably, the size of the electrode negative electrode is (25-35) mm x (80-90) mm. Preferably, the ratio of the width to the length of the electrode cathode is 1: 2.5-3, more preferably 1: 2.7 to 2.9.

According to the negative electrode of the lithium ion battery of the present invention, the negative current collector of the battery negative electrode may be a negative current collector commonly used in lithium ion batteries, such as a stamped metal, a metal foil, a mesh metal, and a foam metal, preferably a copper foil.

According to the negative electrode of the lithium ion battery, the battery negative electrode obtained by various conventional methods for forming the negative electrode material on the negative current collector in the field can be used and can achieve better effects. The inventors of the present invention have found that the cycle life and energy density of the resulting lithium ion battery can be further improved by optimizing the process of forming the anode material.

According to a preferred embodiment, the process of forming the negative electrode material on the negative current collector of the negative electrode for lithium ion batteries according to the present invention comprises the steps of:

(1) mixing the negative electrode active material and the negative electrode conductive agent in the form of dry powder to form mixed powder;

(2) mixing more than half of the negative electrode binder with the mixed powder obtained in the step (1) to form a dough, and continuously stirring for at least 0.8 hour;

(3) and (3) mixing the mixture obtained in the step (2) with the residual negative binder and the negative solvent to obtain slurry, coating the slurry on a negative current collector, and drying and rolling.

The inventor of the present invention finds that, through the above preferred embodiment, premixing at least part of the negative electrode binder, the negative electrode active material and the negative electrode conductive agent for a period of time, so as to coat a layer of binder, namely, PAA-Li glue solution, on the surface of the silicon alloy of the negative electrode active material, wherein the layer of glue solution can function similar to an SEI film, and can effectively inhibit the problem that the SEI film on the surface of the negative electrode plate is damaged due to the huge temperature rise on the surface of the battery during the high-rate charge and discharge of the lithium ion battery, thereby effectively improving the cycle life and energy density of the lithium ion battery.

The amount of the negative electrode binder in the step (2) can account for more than half of all the negative electrode binders, and is preferably 2/3-4/5.

In step (2), the stirring may be continued for at least 0.8 hour, preferably 0.9 to 1.5 hours. The continuous stirring is preferably high-speed stirring, and the stirring speed can be 2000-3500 r/min.

In step (3), the method for applying the slurry to the negative electrode current collector is not particularly limited, and may be performed on various apparatuses commonly used in the art. Generally, the slurry may be coated on the negative electrode current collector using a slurry spreader. The amount of the negative electrode material formed on the negative current collector may be 10 to 20mg/cm2This allows a higher energy density of the lithium ion battery.

In the step (3), the conditions of the baking are not particularly limited as long as the solvent in the anode material can be sufficiently removed, and for example, the baking may be performed at a temperature of 30 to 80 ℃; preferably, the baking may be performed at a temperature of 40-60 ℃. The baking time can be 8-15 min.

The positive electrode of the lithium ion battery comprises a positive current collector and a positive electrode material formed on the positive current collector, wherein the positive electrode material is formed by a positive electrode composition, and the positive electrode composition contains a positive electrode active material, a positive electrode conductive agent and a positive electrode binder.

According to the positive electrode of the lithium ion battery of the present invention, preferably, the lithium ion batteryThe positive electrode active material of the cell contains nickel cobalt manganese lithium acid, more preferably Lia+1NixCoyMnzO2Wherein x + y + z + a is 1, 0<a≤0.1，x≥0.45。

According to the positive electrode of the lithium ion battery of the present invention, based on the total weight of the positive electrode active material, the positive electrode conductive agent, and the positive electrode binder, the content of the positive electrode active material may be 80 to 96 wt%, the content of the positive electrode conductive agent may be 3 to 10 wt%, and the content of the positive electrode binder may be 0.1 to 10 wt%.

According to the positive electrode of the lithium ion battery of the present invention, the positive electrode binder may be a binder conventional in the art, such as at least one of polyvinylidene fluoride (PVDF), polytetrafluoroethylene, polyacrylic acid, sodium carboxymethylcellulose, and polyethylene.

According to the positive electrode of the lithium ion battery of the present invention, the positive electrode conductive agent may be a positive electrode conductive agent conventional in the art. Preferably, the positive electrode conductive agent is a mixture of carbon black and carbon nanotubes, and more preferably, the molar ratio of the carbon black to the carbon nanotubes in the positive electrode conductive agent is 1-5: 1, more preferably 1 to 3:1, e.g. 1-2: 1, wherein the carbon black has an apparent density of 60 to 90kg/m3The specific surface area is 60-80m2A specific conductivity of 102-104S/m, the carbon nanotube refers to a seamless nanotube formed by rolling a single-layer graphite sheet or a plurality of layers of graphite sheets, the carbon nanotube can be single-wall carbon nanotubes (SWCNTs) and/or multi-wall carbon nanotubes (MWCNTs), and preferably, the carbon nanotube is a multi-wall carbon nanotube. The inner diameter ID of the carbon nanotube can be 2-15nm, the outer diameter OD is less than or equal to 30nm, the thickness of the tube wall can be 0.5-10nm, the length can be 5-20 mu m, and the specific surface area can be 150-300m2A specific conductivity of 104-107S/m, preferably, the inner diameter ID of the carbon nanotube is 4-6nm (e.g. 5nm), the outer diameter OD is 5-10nm (e.g. 7nm), the wall thickness is 0.5-2nm (e.g. 1nm), the length is 10-20 μm (e.g. 10-15 μm), and the specific surface area is 200-300m2(e.g. 220- & ltSUB & gt 250 m)2Per g) and an electrical conductivity of 105-107S/m (e.g. 10)5-106S/m)。

According to the positive electrode of the lithium ion battery, the positive electrode material composition further contains a positive electrode solvent. The content of the cathode solvent may be 25 to 50 parts by weight, based on 100 parts by weight of the total weight of the cathode active material, the conductive agent, and the binder. Preferably, the cathode solvent is selected from at least one of N-methylpyrrolidone, N-methylformamide, N-methylacetamide, acetonitrile and N, N-dimethylformamide, and more preferably N-methylpyrrolidone.

The positive electrode of the lithium ion battery according to the present invention, the size and density of the positive current collector and the positive electrode material in the positive electrode of the battery, and other parameters may be in a manner conventional in the art. Preferably, the compacted density of the cathode material is preferably 3-4g/cm3. Preferably, the thickness of the positive current collector is 12-20 μm. Preferably, the amount of the positive electrode material formed on the positive electrode current collector is preferably 36 to 40mg/cm2. Preferably, the size of the electrode positive electrode is (25-35) mm x (80-90) mm. Preferably, the ratio of the width to the length of the electrode positive electrode is 1: 2.5-3, more preferably 1: 2.7 to 2.9.

In the present invention, the lithium ion battery further includes a separator, which may be various conventional separators in the art, such as a polypropylene (PP) separator, a Polyethylene (PE) separator, a PP and PE composite polymer separator, and a PP and/or PE coated Al-coated separator2O3The latter barrier film.

The preparation method of the lithium ion battery of the present invention can be a method known to those skilled in the art, and generally speaking, the method comprises the steps of stacking and assembling the positive electrode, the isolating film and the negative electrode according to a top-down lamination mode, then welding the positive electrode and the aluminum tab, welding the negative electrode and the copper nickel-plated tab, then performing aluminum plastic film heat sealing, injecting electrolyte, vacuumizing and packaging to obtain a battery cell, and obtaining the lithium ion battery through infiltration, formation and vacuumizing again. The infiltration conditions may include: the soaking time is 20-40 h. The formation conditions may include: the formation voltage is 2.75-4.4V.

The present invention will be described in detail below by way of examples, but the scope of the present invention is not limited thereby.

Preparation A1

Test example

The plurality of lithium ion batteries obtained in the above test examples were tested by the following methods, and the results are shown in table 1.

(1) Volumetric energy density of battery

After the obtained lithium ion battery is formed, the lithium ion battery is charged to 4.4V at the temperature of 30 ℃ by a constant current of 0.2C, and then is charged by a constant voltage, and the current is cut off by 0.05C; then, discharging the battery to 2.75V at a constant current of 0.2C to obtain the capacity of discharging the battery to 2.75V at the current of 0.2C at normal temperature, namely the capacity of grading the battery; the cell was then charged to 4.1V at a constant current of 0.2C, removed and weighed.

The cell energy density was calculated as follows: battery energy density (Wh/kg) ═ battery discharge capacity (mAh) ÷ battery weight (g) × operating voltage (V).

(2) Cycle performance

Charging the battery prepared in the experimental example to 4.4V at a constant current of 0.33C at room temperature, then converting the constant current to charge, and cutting off the current of 0.05C; then, the cell was discharged to 3.0V again at a constant current of 5C. Repeating the steps for 200 times to obtain the capacity of the battery which is discharged to 3.0V by 5C current after 200 cycles at normal temperature, and calculating the capacity retention rate of the battery after cycles.

As can be seen from examples 1 to 8 and comparative examples 1 to 3, when the binder of the present invention is used in a lithium ion battery using a negative electrode active material containing a silicon alloy, the battery energy density can reach 240Wh/kg or more, and the battery capacity retention rate can reach 50% or more; the energy density of the lithium ion battery prepared by using the most preferred binder can reach above 270Wh/kg, and the capacity retention rate of the lithium ion battery can reach above 86%. As can be seen from example 8, the binder of the present invention is also well suited for use in lithium ion batteries using graphite as the negative electrode active material, but the energy density of lithium ion batteries using graphite as the negative electrode active material is significantly lower than that of lithium ion batteries containing a silicon alloy negative electrode active material. The capacity retention rate of the lithium ion battery prepared by using the binder of comparative examples 1-2 is more than 30%, and the capacity retention rate of the lithium ion battery prepared by using the binder of comparative example 3 is only 13.2%, so that the problem that the expansion of the silicon alloy cannot be inhibited by the binder of the comparative example can be seen, and the cycle life of the battery is obviously influenced.

As can be seen from examples 1, 9-13 and comparative examples 4-6, when the electrolyte is used for a lithium ion battery taking nickel-cobalt-manganese-lithium acid as a positive electrode active material, the energy density of the battery can reach over 260Wh/kg, and the capacity retention rate of the battery can reach over 58%; the energy density of the lithium ion battery prepared by using the most preferable electrolyte can reach over 270Wh/kg, and the capacity retention rate of the lithium ion battery can reach over 85 percent. The capacity retention rate of the lithium ion battery prepared by the electrolyte of the comparative example is only 11.2%, 7.8% and 56%, which are far lower than that of the lithium ion battery prepared by the electrolyte of the invention. The electrolyte can effectively relieve the problem that the battery capacity of the lithium ion battery usually decays quickly when the electrolyte is used for the lithium ion battery taking nickel-cobalt-manganese lithium acid as the positive active material, thereby obviously prolonging the cycle life of the lithium ion battery, and the lithium ions can keep higher energy density of the battery.

In conclusion, the binder disclosed by the invention is matched with the negative active material containing silicon alloy, and the electrolyte disclosed by the invention can be matched with the positive active material and the negative active material, so that the volume expansion phenomenon of the silicon material can be effectively inhibited, the problem that the battery capacity of a lithium ion battery which takes nickel-cobalt-manganese-lithium acid as the positive active material is quickly attenuated generally can be solved, the service life of the lithium ion battery which uses the nickel-cobalt-manganese-lithium acid positive active material can be effectively prolonged, and the capacity retention rate of the lithium ion battery can be further improved; the lithium ion battery of the invention uses nickel-cobalt-manganese lithium acid with larger gram capacity and silicon alloy, thereby having higher energy density.
